answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 19584 Country: India Title: i am married 4 5 years still dont have child. i had 2 misscarriage. i visited doctor but doctor recommed surgery due 2 endrometrosis.can i go 4 surgery? please tell me dua and bagifa 2 get pregnant as soon as possible. Question: Assalam o alikum ,mufti shabeh i am married 4 5 years still dont have child. i had 2 misscarriage. i visited doctor but doctor recommed surgery due 2 endrometrosis.can i go 4 surgery? please tell me dua and bagifa 2 get pregnant as soon as possible.allah hafiz Answer ID: 19584 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 394/314/B=1431) You would better not to go for surgery. Trust Almighty Allah and beseech Him, and use any medicine to energize your uterus. Recite the following dua extensively: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ [الأنبياء : 89] Our Shaikh Hadhrat Zakariya Muhajir Madani RA had suggested the following amal : Boil two hen eggs early morning and after peeling them write the following ayah on one egg which the husband would eat: وَالسَّمَاء بَنَيْنَاهَا بِأَيْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ [الذاريات : 47] On the other egg write the following ayah which the wife would eat: وَالْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ الْمَاهِدُونَ [الذاريات : 48] This should be done for forty days without any gap, and during this period they should have intercourse as well. It is hoped that Almighty Allah would bless you a child. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
